svg.title: PID holds a weight on the shaft
svg.desc: In the loaded hold PD stays 0.124 radians below its target while PID returns within 0.0015 radians and its integral holds the 1.96 newton-metre load; on an unloaded step the same PID overshoots 0.23 radians with beta 1 and only 0.008 radians with beta 0.3.
svg.text: PID holds a weight on the shaft
Control Studio validation runs on the actual ST · 2 kg on a 0.1 m drum · numbers answer the predictions
Load 1.962 N·m: the integral holds 1.96 N·m on average,
PD holds 0.124 rad below the target
Unloaded step: β 1 overshoots 0.23 rad, β 0.3 only 0.008 rad
